info.name: Retrieve a list of payment methods

params.name: type
params.description: To retrieve methods of a specific type

params.name: customerId
params.description: Mobile number or unique identifier of the customer

params.name: relatedParty.id
params.description: To retrieve methods from a specific related party

params.name: transactionId
params.description: This is the transaction Id from the calling system. This is required if the relatedParty.id is CPG

params.name: description
params.description: Other information, can be a merchant identifier .ie. merchantId etc.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of payment methods

params.name: paymentMethodId
params.description: id of the payment method to update. Tells whether the customer billing type is 'Debit Order' or 'Credit Card' or 'Cash'. Currently 'Cash' is not supported.

params.name: customerMsisdn
params.description: Mobile number or unique identifier of the customer

params.name: providerId
params.description: Impacted party to fullfil the service. This shows which system layer to be called to fulfil the request

params.name: billingAccountNumber
params.description: Billing Account Number on which the update has to be done

params.name: idNumber
params.description: id number or the passport number of the customer

params.name: paymentDay
params.description: Day of the month on which payment will be done against the customer bill. Possible values are between number 1 to 31
